links.outcome: Flesch-Kincaid grade level readability of chatbot responses to patient questions
links.effect: Perplexity most readable (median FK 13.2), ChatGPT least readable (16.8; P < .0001); all above typical patient reading levels.
links.quote: Perplexity was the most readable (median FK 13.2), and ChatGPT the least (16.8; P < .0001).

links.outcome: Expert approval of chatbot responses to red flag postoperative complication questions
links.effect: Experts unanimously approved ChatGPT responses 96% of the time overall and 100% for the 6 Red Flag Questions.
links.quote: Experts unanimously approved ChatGPT responses (mean EOQ = 1) 96% of the time, and 100% for Red Flag Questions.

screen.reason: The study retrospectively evaluated four commercial LLM chatbots on their safety, quality, and readability when responding to common and red-flag patient post-rhinoplasty queries, without testing a specific deployment practice or guardrail.
